Histology shows epidermal necrosis and neutrophilic infiltration, consistent with irritant dermatitis. Chemical burns (C) typically present with more acute, severe features, whereas the chronic ulceration and histopathology align better with an irritant reaction. Pyoderma gangrenosum (A) and allergic contact dermatitis (B) are less supported by the clinical and histological findings.
